However the same can be said for most of the game and chapters, the beautiful thing about morimens is how much freedom you have to use any combination of characters where they all have unique strengths and playstyles! 

That said, please keep in mind I'm not an expert or meta-focused player (I have 100% astral hard ch1-5 without using ecogs and no limited overexalts though, so I'm familiar with playing f2p!) but from your account, this is the "main" team I would personally use! content:
Some general tips and heads up for astral arc 2: be very careful of "emergency contact" enemies (they are headless and hold a phone), as playing non-awakener cards, like insight (ultra focused) and embryo (caro) makes them more powerful and gives them a shield! So aequor has an advantage in these chapters, but **all the realms can work**, just something to keep in mind!
Astral ch1 has many enemies that inflict bleed so a healer or caro team works great, while astral ch2 has a powerful "merge into one" elite enemy (big bugs inside a shell) that stacks poison scaling from non-blocked damage, so a shield-focused team is advised (aequor once again comes in handy for this!)

Plus each chapter-character has a boost in their own chapter that make them a great pick to use! Also don't forget to upgrade soulforge in character's "talent" menu

Final tip is to ask if you've had a look at **Cheri's Handbook** yet? It's an incredible resource that offers lots of character advice and teams, which is backed by the top players! 

Also sorry I know you said english isn't your first language so apologies if anything is confusing! Let me know if you have any further question or need clarifications :)

Alya has given a great reply already, but I also want to add on with some extra reassurance (as a traphase fiend haha) 

If you're still new to draft-pick or all-pick, you get the benefit to sometimes **playing against the bot**! This bot will have the standard keeper avatar, you can't like/friend them and they don't emote. So try to use the wave emote and if they don't respond back (and don't emote if you take a long time during your turns), it means you can take your time and carefully read everything, as that means you're either playing against the bot or a patient keeper <3 

Plus if you have a low score, there's a higher chance to play against other new players who are learning and taking their time, just like you!

I started playing traphase before astral reign so there was far less characters, wods and posses to read and memorize via the menu. With the current cast of characters and gear available, it's far more effective to read/learn during the draft-pick selection and during matches like Alya suggested

Just like the pve side of the game, the more matches you play in pvp, the more familiar you'll get with the cards and different interactions/combos that work well together, good luck!!<:Ogier_cheer:1468259351889318049>

Also a heads up that if you have the time for another round of dzone before reset, there's currently a bug where next week's update was accidentally put out early, so the difficulties are much easier! I was able to hit 500 and clear 5 madness runs, so using those same teams you could reach 400-450 with ease, if interested! 

Back to your question, I don't typically give pull advice as it varies player to player (everyone has their own different playstyles, goals and fave characters), so please keep this in mind! That said, personally I suggest using your selector on Caucus for his e12, as his AA upgrade is incredible and he's a very versatile character that works on many teams with high healing output, plus when you pull an e12 dupe, you get sendiment and soul rewinds that allows you to select limited characters! (also I noticed he's still lv60, the enlightens have unlocked a free lv70 cap) 

From your missing standards; I don't use Uvhash, Karen, Liz or Tinct (they don't fit my playstyle and have been outclassed by limited characters imo) so I can't advocate for them as strongly as someone who does main or like them, but if any of them catch your eye, it doesn't hurt to give a test run in the trials to gauge your interest. Casiah has a unique skill to pull cards from the ultra space so she's been vital to many endgame comps lately (most notably c:lotan so she can reuse short and long blades), very helpful to finish battles that just needs ONE more attack to win or seeking a specific card, so she'd be a safe bet to select

Celeste's e1 and e2 retain effects are in my opinion the most impactful enlightens from your roster, other than that, please select whichever characters you personally enjoy most!<:Thais_yes:1356053037159944473>
